long_description:
Registration is open for our fall HEALING WITH MANTRAS kirtan retreat at @kripalucenter October 9 - 12, 2026. These dates fill up quickly (it's Indigenous People's Day /Columbus Day weekend!) so reserve your spots early! 

In this program, we'll learn and practice healing mantras from the Tibetan Buddhist and Tibetan medical traditions and experience their effects on our minds, our chakras, our hearts, and the energy channels of the subtle body.

📿 In the mornings, we'll practice simple mantra recitation (speech-level spoken chants) and silent chanting (inner-voice chanting) to activate healing energies and quell inner and secret obstacles. 

🎶 In the afternoons and select evenings, we'll practice kirtan (call-and-response chanting) and sing devotional mantras from the Buddhist and Hindu traditions.

This retreat is an opportunity to learn and practice deep rest and deep self-care. 

You will:

- learn how to use your own voice and sound currents to heal your own body, voice, and mind. 💫

- immerse in the profound beauty of the Kripalu campus, nestled in the Berkshire Mountains, and enjoy trail hikes, boating, and guided outdoor activities at peak foliage season. And nature, as we know, is good medicine. 🌈

- Enjoy world-class food (based on Ayurvedic principles), Ayurvedic spa treatments, and a wide array of yoga/meditation/dance/art classes to choose from. 🔥

- enjoy the company of supportive and like-minded community who are committed to being of benefit to all beings 

- Receive guidance and instruction for home practice.

-------------------------------------------------

Unravel Your Core Patterns

In times of stress, emotional upheaval, trauma, and loss, our life force and vital essence energies can get depleted, leaving us feeling anxious, depressed, confused, numb, or cut off from our true selves.
